name: nika
description: A Network Arena for Benchmarking AI Agents on Network Troubleshooting

paragraphs: ✨ Features · 🤖 Overview · 📦 Installation · 🚀 Quick start · 📖 Learn more · 📄 Docs · 🌐 Website · 📚 Cite

Think about SWE-Bench, but for network troubleshooting. NIKA, Network Incident Benchmark for AI Agents, is an open benchmark for agentic evals on network troubleshooting tasks. NIKA reproduces network incidents across data center and campus networks, enterprise WAN overlays, ISP backbones, SDN and P4 fabrics, Kubernetes clusters, and vendor routing environments. It connects any agent directly to a live network stack while the incident is ongoing, evaluating the ability of the AI agent to troubleshoot the network using network diagnostic tools, switch CLIs, and network telemetry data. You…
NIKA lets you plug in any LLM or agent framework and measure its operational capability under identical, reproducible conditions.
features: Network emulators: Use NIKA with Kathará or Containerlab to run live networks without physical hardware.
Pre-built tasks: Troubleshoot network incidents without building the setup yourself. NIKA deploys the network and injects the faults.
Bring your AI agent: Use the included Claude Code, Codex, or LangGraph agents, or connect your own harness.
Agent sandboxing: Run supported agents in isolated sandboxes, with controlled access to the network, filesystem, and tools.
Fair evaluation: Evaluate incident detection, localization, and diagnosis under reproducible conditions, and submit your results to the leaderboard.
